statements.text: Given a mathematical object isomorphic to the qualia of a system, the property that corresponds to how pleasant it is to be that system is the symmetry of that object.
statements.scope: any conscious system for which qualia formalism holds

sources.quote: Given a mathematical object isomorphic to the qualia of a system, the mathematical property which corresponds to how pleasant it is to be that system is that object's symmetry.
the symmetry of this representation will encode how pleasant the experience is
